text:
Good brunch menu.  Food was hot and fresh.  Good service and a clean dining room.

They have a great menu with something for just about everyone.  The quality of the food is excellent.
Great burgers and awesome service. Definitely going back! I got the barnyard burger with a little bit of everything on it and it was amazing!

Five ladies from So Cal and one young man friend who lives in Metairie ate breakfast here in July of 2020. It was quite possibly the best breakfast I have ever had personally - and everyone else loved theirs as well! It was the first time I attempted chorizo...and decided to do so after finding out they make it themselves. It was delicious! I will never turn up my nose at chorizo again :) Thank you, Daisy Dukes, for wonderful service, great cooking, and delicious eating! We will be back next time we come to New Orleans!

This restaurant was awesome!  I called on a Saturday night and although it was fully booked they save a couple of tables near where the
Chefs are preparing the food.  That was really fun to watch, the artistry of it.  I got an incredible white wine with the brick oven chicken.  Also had the Brussels sprouts for an appetizer, which were fantastic!  I'm definitely coming back!

We stopped in for brunch on our way back to Cincy. It was around 1 on a Sunday and we waited about 15 min for a table. We asked our server for suggestions and she suggested the sampler so we could try everything. We ordered the southern sampler to star. I ordered the catfish meal and my husband ordered chicken and a sweet potato waffle.  The kitchen was backed  up so it took a long time for our food to come out. Our server made sure our drinks were filled in the meantime and they have plenty of TVs so the NFL games kept us entertained. When our food came, we noticed everything was in styrofoam boxes even though we were dining in? Not sure if that is normal or due to COVID. The sampler was so much food! The salmon bites were my favorite and I would order salmon next time I visit. My catfish was cooked to crispy perfection and the sides were delicious. My husband also enjoyed his meal. We had plenty of food to take home. We left full and sleepy.
The food was great a good bang for your buck. Our waiter Mathew made the night truly memorable
Bagels are way too thick. Not soft and chewy with a crispy outside. Very average at best. Also, they didn't toast my bagel and the lox is extremely low quality.

We stopped in this evening was very busy was ok slow to get drink and waited on. We ordered pizza was backed up a bit but that's ok. Seen our pizza come up then discussions between waitress and cook. Then they rearrange toppings then put back in oven. When called out would make over at this point been waiting and tired from long drive. So no discount or anything. Had nothing but great experience in dining since been in Madeira Beach. Also the pours of liquor are half other restaurants on the beach

Not much to look at from the outside, but it was good food and good service. 

Additional info on subsequent visit

Oh Flying with Jerome you let me down!  I had eaten there once before and I liked the food so I thought  I would bring my family and friends here but the next time I came with a very good friend for breakfast my friend asked to substitute out goat cheese for the Brie. Waitress said no problem, but when bill came they added on money for the substitution. The waitress didn't let us know at the time. My friend thought it was wrong but flying with Jerome said too bad.  Not cool or customer friendly.

I have been here a few times for dinner and usually make a reservation. I find the menu to be an authentic offering of Turkish food. I usually get the salmon entrée as this also comes with a salad. They also provide bread and olive oil for the table. It is in a shopping mall and so can be looked over but that would be a mistake. The prices are reasonable and the ambiance is nice.
This is one of my favorite pizza places in the area. It's a fluffy thin crust if that's makes sense. I also highly recommend the meatballs.

The restaurant is usually very busy. It's a restaurant where you can take your kids. There are plenty of tables. The menu has many options. We ordered hamburgers and fries. For me, the food was too greasy. I instantly felt sick but the other people I dined with, they enjoyed their food. We had plenty of food left for leftovers. The food portions are huge. 
I don't think this restaurant is a fit for me but for other people, they seem to really enjoy the food and restaurant.

At first I was very skeptical about trying Saigon because of its 3 star rating on yelp but MAN I have got to say the pho is phonomenal (as I eat pho in Seattle at least once a week). I will definitely be back when visiting SB!!!

This "hole in the wall" place is just the spot for fresh seafood and beer/wine.  With outside seating and occasional live music it is a "hidden gem". It's not fancy or sophisticated but the seafood is fresh and plentiful.
Great restaurant but the prices will break your bank 2 eggs 1 bagel fruit coffee  My husband had the same breakfast like I said be prepared to open the bank up

Another great meal at Commoner & Co. we've been coming here routinely since it opened. Really pleased with the new remodel and menu overhaul. Such great food, atmosphere and service. Tonight's personal favorite was the ragú tagliatelle! Just spectacular house made pasta, fresh sauce and braised beef. The salmon and steak were perfectly cooked and the deserts were pretty amazing. I really like this place, I am glad they added some pillows to the seats. The drink menu looked outstanding and creative. I'm surely you'll love it, if you give it a try.

Service terrible, tables dirty and not wiped down during covid. Classic philly has liquid cheese and a cold hoagie?? Server suggested crab fries, unsure why because no crab. Total $35. Would not suggest anything at this place.

My former roommates are big fans of this place. My partner and I had never been, so we tagged along for Sunday lunch. The place was decently full around 1 pm, and the customers socially distanced themselves on their own. That was cool. Even more cool was the staff ALL wearing masks and gloves, and really cleaning well after a table was vacated. You can definitely eat here with confidence! Now for the food. I'd say it was a step above "run of the mill." It was good, don't get me wrong, but I didn't have anything that really stood out for me, short of the sweet Thai chili sauce that was served with our alligator bites appetizer. I had the half and half special (maybe it's  the 50/50 special?) which was a cup of seafood gumbo (pretty good stuff, that! Plus, you get your choice of any of the soups!) and half a po'boy. I had the soft shell crab po-boy which was ok. I tend to go for something spicy with a definite kick, but this unfortunately didn't deliver it. I could have poured on some hot sauce, but that didn't seem to be the answer. I asked for some remoulade, which made it better, but it still lacked something, not sure what. My partner had the catfish platter. When I asked him how it was, he shrugged and said, "Catfish is catfish." Again, nothing to make it stand out. Also, he ordered some jambalaya, and the girl ringing up the order actually repeated it to him, but still neglected to add it to our order. (How does THAT work?!) When the server brought the food, my partner me
This amazing sushi, probably one of the best places in Philly. You will not be disappointed, everything you order will be fresh and delicious and the service outstanding.

I ordered whole snapper and blackened grouper, the fishes are super dry and fishy. The salad with ranch dressing tasted nothing. The soup was horrible. It took so long to get served. No idea where were these good reviews come from. won't back again and not recommend to anyone in the town.

Not only Chinese food. Decoration is good. Service is awesome!

Can't wait to go again!
This spot is located in a strip with a variety of West African restaurants. They had the most options. Service was good. Very intimate spot and the guy who helped us was very helpful.
Absolutely loved this place! Delicious and seems like they are taking Covid-19 precautions seriously.

High quality ingredients and great atmosphere. Mellow music played during eating. Waiter was a bit overloaded, so service and drink fills, while cheerful, lagged a bit. Fresh squeezed orange juice was excellent. Vegetarian chilli side was ok, but not memorable. Fries were excellent. Pulled pork sandwich was good, but it excellent. 

Overall, a nice place to casual dine, but not premium for the price.

I wish I had take. Pics but I was so hungry and missed fast food from being 'quarantined'!  I've been cooking each night for the last few weeks and tonight I said NO!  I need pizza!  I wanted  to try a new place and so glad I did!!  We had the meat lovers and Bianca pizzas. Plus some fried Ravioli and fried zucchini. Let me tell you!   It was all delicious!!!!  SO fresh!  Crust perfect!  Loved the sauce!! 
The packaging was also something to chat about!  (Damn I wish I took a pic) it was sealed! And said sealed with love! Our driver called me when it was here and waited in his car for us to get it off our door step..... coronavirus caution steps here!!!  
I am thrilled with this place!!  We had a local place we were going to but they had been declining for a while so I'm happy we now have a go to place for amazing pizza.

Went for the "World Famous Sausage Gravy". I am a diner fan and lived in the South so I've had my share of sausage gravy and biscuits. The biscuits and gravy base had potential-  but what a disappointment! Not a single sausage crumble in the entire dish. No kidding- not a speck Most disappointing was basic restaurant sanitation by the staff.  Filled glasses delivered stacked on top of each other so the bottom of one was sitting in the beverage of the bottom glass. Hostess eating and touching her face without ever washing her hands throughout our visit. Not to mention no staff wearing masks. Won't be back.

EXCELLENT‼

Restaurant very clean, service very good, food nicely plated and excellent price is very reasonable.

BEST egg rolls I have EVER had!!!

Same food as every other chick-fil-a, so it's obviously good. But my goodness, would it kill the employees to be even semi aware of their surroundings? I come here all the time because it's a mile from my house, but I'll literally stand there for 10 minutes waiting for someone to acknowledge I need something. Won't even approach me, I have to come after them. The manager whom is always there in the morning is the same way. Doesn't interact with customers, just stands there with a nasty face and looks away. 
Tempted to drive to the one in Brentwood from now on just so I feel the sense of hospitality Chick-fil-A proudly boasts about.

Went in and ordered chicken fried steak they gave me a sausage patty and eggs. Their blueberry pancakes were disappointing.  Just blueberries thrown on the top. I called and told them and was instructed to bring it back. I was already in bed and comfortable. She said well the waiter said u looked at it. (I have been up 20 hours and only thing i saw waa white eggs that i salted and peppered the meat was hiding under it and thpught nothing of it cause gravy was white and it didnt think anything of it,  I wasn't trying to check if the order was wrong it was the last thing on my mind) Then they said to save it and they will replace it. At this point im tired hungry and fed up. I said whatever I'll bring it now.... i can appreciate someone else tried tp chat me up and smooth it over but it doesnt change the fact that the order was wrong im wasting time and and gas for thier mistake and they kept the tip!

My (now husband) and I love this place. We actually had one or our first dates here, AND got engaged here! Overall, the ambiance is great, the service is always impeccable and the food is fantastic. Not to mention a really good wine menu. We have even gotten take out during COVID and found it just as good. Overall, 5 stars.

I was very impressed with this vegan establishment. My mother ordered the nachos that had cashew nacho cheese as the substitute, and it was delicious. I ordered the Southern Po Boy, and while I'm not a huge bread fan (I ordered it because I had to try a po boy down in NOLA, right;)), the fried tofu was flavored wonderfully. And our waitress couldn't have been more enthusiastic and sweet. Thank you!

GREAT FOOD! It was my first time the other night. I had a gyro plate it was amazing I love the hummus and pita bread. We came a little late in the night so I will excuse the slow service because I am in the industry myself but hopefully that's not consistent. Will try again
Favorite ice cream place in Indy! Great, creative flavors and not ridiculously sweet. My favorite is the Zanzibar (deep chocolate flavor) and the peanut butter cook or dough. Can't go wrong!

This place is so cute and the food is delicious!

I came for brunch and ordered the ravioli and the squid ink spaghetti. Both were around $16, which is a great price for Italian food. I loves the squid ink spaghetti, which was filled with calamari and crab with a rich tomato sauce. The ravioli had a subtle flavor, which was buttery and tasty, but a bit too subtle for my liking. 

I did outdoor dining with my boyfriend, and we were socially distanced from the other tables and had a nice seat away from the street. Would recommend coming here with friends or on a cute brunch date!

Best. African. Food.

Cassava fries with onion gravy, fried chicken wings, and jollof on a different level! I could eat their jollof rice every day if I could. Chicken is perfectly crispy and the spicy sauce with it is sooo good! Workers are great and quick to help. Will definitely come back the next time I'm in Philly.

This is a special place. It sneaks up on you. The food is universally wonderful. The staff is professional and attentive. The management is the secret weapon. They are all from the same family, and they treat you as if you were part of their family. 

Generous pours, great food, and an atmosphere that is conducive to easy conversation across the table. A true treasure, right in the heart of Kirkwood.

Incredible meal!!! One of the most delicious ever and I am a total foodie.   The roasted beet salad was fresh and full of flavor, the Cesar salad was the best- chilled grilled lemon so delicious.  The staff was friendly gave great suggestions and stayed open for my friend and I to finish our meal and throughly enjoy our desserts.  What are the chances we could get a Commoner & Co in Phoenix?
Just great tacos - love the carnitas, carne asada, and fish. They often have I interesting daily specials. Great for catering too.
Love this little place. Good wine, excellent cuban sandwiches. An oasis of peace under the giant shade trees.

Hole in the wall, definitely worth a visit. Friendly staff, friendly patrons. They (patrons and staff) went out of their way to help us hoist our mom who was in a wheelchair onto their bar stool height dining chair. Dino's does (p not have low chairs, only bar height dining, FYI. 

Some of the best Caesar salad dressing I've had. 

My mom' s burger looked amazing. I snagged one of her waffle fries, very good, done nice and crispy. 

Very nice waitstaff. Would definitely go back.

This place opened at the beginning of the year. What a diamond to view in Collinsville. We had a large group on a Saturday afternoon. The server was a little slow. They ended up forgetting one persons order. The beer selection was impressive and the spirit menu was what I enjoyed. Gin, bourbon and my favorite vodka.My drink order had a presentation with it. The drink changed colors when the compounds were combined. This is on the old newspaper building hence the name. Go check it out.

What the what now? This place deserves all the praise and phenomenal reviews. Jalapeño bacon, yes please! Belgian waffles, yes please. I really need to come back and try out their lunch specials because their corned beef was ridiculous looking! 

Tip: get here early if it's a weekend. It's packed! But even despite us getting there around 1130am on a Sunday, we got in pretty quickly - about a 10-15 minute wait, which was surprising because it looked like it would be a lot longer than that.

Great addition to the area. I got some treats before Xmas. The caramel cinnamon donuts lived up to the hype. The pecan rolls are to die for!  Huge, gooey and totally loaded with pecans. Never had one so good other than my mom's. The cinnamon bun was a disappointment, as it had way way too much icing. The nut crunch candy is very good - kind of a cross between peanut brittle and a praline. Soft and easy to eat. They are getting their wings at this location and cashier staff is still learning.

The food is just okay, I wasn't really impressed with it at all. It's definitely overpriced. I didn't hate it, but I didn't love it.

I had the steak salad, my husband had the tempura shrimp (which is a stretch on the word tempura). 

The key lime was pretty good though.

The scenery is okay. They definitely could use a deep cleaning in the outdoor seating.
Great empanadas. I spent five years in Latin America and these were as good as any I had South of the border. Will come here again!
Wish i could give zero stars. Likely the worse Taco Bell in St Louis. Clueless area mgrs and franchise owner. AVOID!! Go to t bell on Lemay Ferry near Lindbergh.

I went the other day! Food was amazing!! Service was not so much. The server took forever to come back to my table each time. But the food made up for it :) I ordered the chicken chimichanga and a side of beans.

I'm not sure if the virus is causing an absence of daycare but employees had their children running around all over the place. Kids inside running around the bar and around the outside seating. Have many pictures but thought it would be inappropriate post pictures. You should offer a grown-up environment when are you charge grown up prices.

Locals seem to gather here.  Large bar selection beer and liquor  Large sandwich selection, subs, quesadilla, build your own burgers, fish taco.  Would suggest wider selection tacos and maybe night plate special. Large selection of sides including Brussel sprouts, seasoned fries.  Recommend as sandwich and beer place, not a fine dine place.  Friendly staff and good service.

Being foodies and drinkers from NY, We Love love love this place. First time going and not the last. We stayed from a Thursday to Monday around the corner, and ate and drank three times there ! The service and food are fantastic. The portions are insane- all the condiments are homemade. Prices are so reasonable. The location is cool, pretty sunset sky! Enough shade if warranted and Love the big glasses of water the provide on top of whatever else you order. Literally- every staff member was excellent. Muscles are phenomenal, crab cakes amazing, chicken fingers so authentic as well as the cheese sticks with marinara. Hope to see you soon! Also- much credit given to everyone who works their butt off in the May/June Florida heat !
Best fried chicken around you might have to wait 10-15 min for it but that's because it's fresh out the fryer, every time.

Recommended as a place to try for to go in Nashville, and it was great. You can order in advance on their website and select a time to pick up your meal. It's great, the email confirmation you receive from your order has a spot to tap when you arrive to pick it up!

Wanted to support a local business but was pretty disappointed in both the service and food. Ordered a 14'' veggie deluxe pizza and a side of jalapeño poppers. I picked them up on time but both items were room temperature. After getting home I realized that the deluxe pizza had no red sauce on it (it tasted okay but I was really craving red sauce) We called the store asking about this and the worker said "thanks" and then hung up on us. The jalapeño poppers were delicious (would be even better if they were warm) but the pizza was less than mediocre.

Love Sabrinas! Only gave this place 4 stars because it's literally so small in here it's a bit uncomfortable, however, it doesn't stop me from coming back to get some of that delicious food! (I prefer sitting outside in the summer) I always get the avocado toast, build my own omelet and veggie sausage fried well done. Yum!
Two dope chicks of New Orleans was great. Service was top notch and the food incredibly.

I had the pleasure of taking my boyfriend to have Indian frybread. He is a chef and he absolutely loved the savory version and the sweet version. Unfortunately we were not able to dine there as it was closed for a birthday party, but next time we want to try it fresh out of the oven. Even though we had to take a Lyft back to where we were staying and it wasn't piping hot, it was still delicious. I had the sautéed nopalitas and squash and they were delicious. I had a bit of the Indian fry bread with honey and powdered sugar and it was amazing. Next time, I will definitely order more!!!

We and a group of friends have known the owner Ashu for several years and have been his regular customers. We have generally liked the food. Given the relationship abd prior experience, we decided to organize a party of 20 people. We booked the newer place that he has next to the earlier one in the same complex. It was a very bad experience. Starting from service, quality of food, billing, it was a really bad experience. Everything was bad. He doesn't have any experience in organizing parties and it showed. The worst party ever... after every get together / party we have a custom of thanking everyone/each other and complimenting each other... not this one... the only party ever that no one said any good thing even as a formality. Will never think of organizing any party there. He ruined our experience.
Perfectly crunchy and thin! I love a good New York style pizza and Tony's nailed it! YUUUUMMMM!

First time in my life that I order dinner and send it back . I order grilled salmon how hard can that be when it came it smelled rotten so I send it back and order a cup a soup ( broth with some onions ) and tons of salt so to said the least I left with a glass a wine and bread . First and last time for us table of four we all left hungry and went somewhere else after spending $140

What a great place for graduation celebration where teens and adults both enjoyed the menu and its variety.  People were super friendly and able to answer all our questions etc..
I've gotta come back on October with my own teenager
Good food and super friendly staff. Great place to eat and hangout with your friends. I brought my dog with me and they even gave my dog water even if I didn't ask for it.

Met the manager of this restaurant elsewhere and he invited us to all come in to dinner.  Had friends whose daughter was touring UCSB so decided to bring our whole group in.  What a great experience.  The food and wine were absolutely fabulous and although they were super busy, we were never neglected. All of the dishes that we ordered were delicious, so I can't just recommend one!  Try as many as possible!  We will most definitely be back!

Stopped in to Casa Vieja for a late lunch today. I was craving some fajitas.

Service: Was not busy at all so waiters were sitting around, no problem. Problem is my waiter would sit with other waiters and forget he had a table. I had to try and wave him down for anything I needed. It got annoying.

Food. I ordered the Chicken and Steak Fajitas. The meat comes cut in tiny tiny pieces. I couldn't find a piece is steak or chicken the size of a dime. I definitely feel like there was way more veggies than meat. Flavor? It tasted pretty good, well seasoned for sure. I just can't get passed the mini tiny honey I shrunk the food meat pieces. 

I don't think I'll be coming back because the kibble n bits meat pieces are a huge turnoff. Too many Mexican places in town to not enjoy a first visit.
Not as good as the best middle eastern joints but a welcome addition to the neighborhood.

Ate there on their first day, was great. Curry bento bix and teriyaki vegetable bento box were delicious. Came w California roll, Goya, salad, miso and rice. All were great. Note no "special" sushi rolls, those are pretty basic, but good and fresh. Will definitely be back!

Great ambience, nice for a date night. Everything was fresh (house made). You can see the cooks make the pizza right in front of your face if you are sitting at the bar towards the back. I definitely plan on going back!!!!

Stopped by this place for a quick bite today while our running errands. It's a small spot with about four or five tables inside with additional ones on the outside patio. Arrived there about 12:15 and only one table was left inside to eat at. I ordered a slice which had pepperoni, sausage, bacon and meatballs along with a drink. Total was $4 and some change. 

The pizza was sitting out like a real NY/NJ pizza place so you could see what you were getting. Took about three minutes and the pizza was ready. Man that pizza was delicious!!!  The crust was perfectly cooked with a nice snap to it. All the meat on there was plenty to have on one slice. 

By the time I finished my slice, there was a line almost out the door of customers. I can see why they like this place. I'll be back again to try a sub or a pasta meal. It's a nice friendly little pizza joint.

On the south side of Indy and was in the lookout for some healthy fare. I found this place in Yelp and dropped in. I was  not disappointed. The owner Erica was very congenial and helpful with explaining what they had to offer.  I tried the stir fry with shrimp and it was freshly made with plenty of veggies and enough for 2 meals. I noted that she did meal prep so I ordered two meals to take to work while I was in town own. The rib eye and salmon were nicely flavored with fresh vegetables and quinoa. It made finding something to take to work so simple. I also tried their brownies which are made with black beans and avocado but you wouldn't know from the taste. It was delicious and moist. I recommend this place highly and will use them for my meal preps when I come in town to work.

Absolute best sushi in Tampa! Fresh ingredients, friendly service, great menu and reasonable prices. What else do you need? They are centrally located and very easy to get to no matter where in Tampa you're coming from.

Had lunch with my dad today. This is my second time to a P.F. Chang's. The first time I didn't like it at all. This is my first time at this location and along with the food the service was excellent. Our server was Blake and he was very helpful with descriptions of the items and suggestions. He even suggested a certain vodka for my dad's Bloody Mary and my dad was very impressed! I got water and the glass was never empty. He didn't bug the heck out of us but he was there whenever we needed him. He had a couple tables that I could see but he stayed on his game! I hope that was his name... if not he's the bald guy that worked open today lol. We got chicken lettuce wraps for starters that were awesome. The lettuce was so fresh and the chicken was juicy. I forget what my dad ordered for the meal. It was a honey chicken maybe. It had a kick and it was a shared plate with noodles under. Blake said it had a kick but it was mostly sweet... Blake must eat hot Cheetos for snack cause that kick was a kick bro! Lol I might be a light weight but my nose was definitely watering. It was delicious though!

So, my job relocated within Center City so I have an excuse to explore and check out some new places for lunch.  Pizza Fresca is one new place.

Based on a single slice of pizza, I'm giving three stars.  It was not spectacular, but wasn't bad.  It is a big slice in my picture, and tasted like it had fresh ingredients.  

I wasn't a fan of the pizza oven that looked liked a giant light-bright instead of what I'm used to.  

Their menu says they have a second level to rent out for parties.  They also have salads, appetizers, pasta, hoagies (subs), cheesesteaks, and various types of pizza.

Lots of other places to try!

First and LAST time at this place. I was really craving wings so I thought what better place to try than somewhere that has wings in their name! Boy was I wrong. I ordered the combo (6 traditional wings, 6 boneless) with medium sauce, and a side of fries. The sauce on the wings had no flavor at all. It was watery and completely tasteless. The fries were extremely soggy. Overall, it was disappointing and I won't be going back.

This is the worst location in Indy. We ordered from this  location three different times and something was wrong with our order all three times. Another group ordered from there and we told them our experience. They came back and told use their orders were messed up. How does this happen? We have since started ordering from Mile Square. So far so good.
I would not get a web order or phone order from this location. If you go in and watch them make it you might be okay. 

I will no longer give them any business.
I had a wonderful meat free meal here, perhaps surprisingly.  My biggest suggestion for improvement is to offer a vegetarian platter that includes more sides and some type of meat free main.

After a disappointing dinner the previous night, I thought great cooking had left New Orleans. But our faith was restored at K-Paul's. Even their intro bread basket was outstanding! I then moved on to the spinach salad and got the extra fried shrimp. Wow, not only was the salad great, but the breading on the 8 fried shrimp was also great. Next was the 2 steak fillets cooked in a cast iron skillet with a delicious debris reduction sauce. Wow...  at our waiter's recommendation, we got their version of creme brûlée for dessert which had a praline bottom - the best we ever had, even better than the Four Seasons in Paris! I'm glad I got my own and didn't have to share it! We thanked the kitchen staff for the outstanding dinner and our waiter, Randolph, for all his recommendations.

this place is a classic!! i literally ate here every saturday after shopping at the mall ALL day with my family, when i was younger. specifically the atlanta location. i moved to baton rouge and of course craved this classic so i literally DROVE to new orleans for this lol. let me just say this was the first time i've been to an empty cheesecake factory... like no wait nothing my friend and i probably were 2 of 10 in this restaurant. with that being said we asked if we could sit outside and they said no okay whatever. i love this menu because of the variety. our waitress brought out our strawberry lemonade like half full ??? we looked confused so then she instantly brought out another full glass.... okay. i ordered the club being that it was lunch and my friend oredered the louisiana chicken pasta... you would expect this pasta to taste 10x better since we were in LOUISIANA... lol wrong it had no sauce so she sent it back. overall this was the worst cheesecake ive ever been to. the food here is not top notch fine dining but it's a classic you can never go wrong with. however, this location was a MISS. i'll stick to the ones back home in atlanta

Beautiful place. Front area seemed Very clean, tasted delicious, service was pretty good. 
They care and follow up with customers to assure they had a good experience.

Very good food and service.  Recommend the Brushetta.  I couldn't eat it all!  We both loved this place and the area.  Traveling and staying in area for a few days and found it on the list provided by our hotel.

Very disappointed with the service at this establishment today. It was my 5th time going within the last 2 months and we always had a good time. This time I decided to go with friends and our small kids. They immediately treated us as though we were an inconvenience. Hostess Morgan was clearly bothered by our presence. Despite us paying $35 to rent chairs, another $70 or so for food and drinks she decided to send over a manager to our beach area to tell us we had to take our small cooler back to our car. We were with 3 children under the age of 2 who drink milk so it was insane to me they could even request this. The manager Chris didn't care one bit and when I asked him if he was really going to make me walk all the way back to my car with small kids he said yes of course our rules are on our website, very condescendingly. I checked the website when I got home and have yet to find these rules posted. We have always been treated exceptionally well whenever we come and during covid I have made it a point to tip my waitresses over 40% since I understand the industry has been hit hard. However, I will not be returning to Shephards. There are tons of other options in the area that I am sure will treat paying customers alot better. Morgan and Chris need some customer service training or maybe to simply be taught some compassion towards other people.
OMG - absolutely the best cheese steak sandwich I've ever had!!!!     Call ahead and order as the wait can be considerable since they are so popular.

Nothing has changed.  Clearly ownership is not looking at the reviews, but certainly not making any adjustments to try to improve the service. Order time remains extremely poor and the food quality has now taken a major hit. Wont be back until I see a steady flow of positive reviews. Really unfortunate.
Food is good but like nothing outstanding. It's a bit pricey but understandable for the location.
Beautiful patio outside seating. Be careful of homeless stealing. The food is good. I love Santa Barbara.
Cute little stop downtown great $5 pho Tuesday's! They had a nice wine and beer selection. Spring rolls to die for. Andrew was very attentive and made our night amazing would just go back to see him.
This joint in Wayne is a goto spot for drinks and small plates. Their drinks list goes beyond the vast selection of whiskeys. And the food is surprisingly top shelf. Real nice ambiance too.

Honestly not worth the money. My fiancé and I went here because we hear great things. The outdoor seating was very nice. The service it self was lack luster. We sat down for a total of a  hour and half it took about 20 minutes to get my drink, which tasted like rubbing alcohol. I put all the food in at one because I want to try the small plates and my fiancé order the beef bowl. The food can be described as one word SALTY! Omg I was so sick after. The food was for the most part cold when it came out which I'm not sure if it was because we were outside of because they just didn't care. The couple next to us was complaining when we got there. I should have took their advice on this. Please if you have any condition that you cannot have salt, I would stay away!!
One day their lobby is open for orders, next day it's closed. It's really inconvenient, especially when the drive thru line is long and it's lunch time.

Great local spot for a high quality
Meal . Prices are high but if
You want A quality and don't want to travel to Tampa then this is the spot
Green light bar has great food and fun atmosphere. We enjoyed a game of pool and a wonderful CBD coffeeCool jukebox

This is our favorite Asian Fusion restaurant, bar none! The food is stellar and super fresh, the presentations creative and beautiful, and the dining experience is lovely and calm, never rushed. Man and his wife create a peaceful and delicious atmosphere every time. We even got married here! We give this place our highest recommendation!

A friend and I came here and shared the Bourbon Bacon Cheddar fondue. It stated it was 10.45. But it's apparently $10.45 a person. Same amount of cheese as if it was one person and items to dip in the cheese. Such a rip off. Would not recommend.

Once again, came in to try karaoke...once again dance music occupied 50% of the evening. Who cares if there's a populated roster of singers waiting to do their thing. The k.j. plays dance music 30 minutes at a time. My photo is of the dance floor during one of the extended dance breaks...sooo...let people sing. People can dance to the singers...

Enter the drive thru behind one car. They took the left ordering one and I took the right. Since they got there first I understood when the voice on the speaker told me that she's be with me in a moment. But then I sat there for 5 minutes in astonishment when I see that all the cars at the window paid, got their food, and left including the one that rolled up with me and I'm here, the only car in any part of the drive thru. Poor customer service for forgetting to serve a customer that was patiently waiting. Wound up just driving out of the drive thru and went elsewhere.

We came here on a night that was super slammed. We had a great experience! From the good food, to the great music, and to our fantastic server, Jeff Waters, this place really had it all! Can't wait to come back on our next trip...maybe we will ge so lucky to get Jeff as our server again. Thank you!!

Happily waited for an incredibly long time but thought it would be worth it. When we were sat, the place was not as clean as you would like to see it during a pandemic. Also, I witnessed an employee named Cody berate an guy with a service animal even after the guy showed the dogs certification. All around shockingly unprofessional and I was surprised to see how much that employee did not mesh with the usually kind and inviting environment.
The Curry Bird has the best shrimp pho with huge shrimp. The sesame noodles lacks in flavor. I wish they offered shrimp tempura. Overall a good experience.

This was one of the very few that allowed my family of 5 to sit together. The service was excellent...very attentive even though I know she was working several tables. The food was delicious...portions enormous. There's usually something I can find might be a little off...not one thing...it was timely and delicious!

Visiting Tampa for a short weekend and friend recommended Osteria, especially since it was below where we were staying. Food was awesome and server was kind and knowledgeable since it was our first time there. Frozé was so good and the donut dessert (unsure of name) but that was my all time favorite part (mostly because I love donuts) but would def visit again in the future.

The Growler Guys was a very convenient location in proximity to my home. So many beers on tap. I had a hard time choosing. My brother got food and it was alright. Basic bar food. The tots were not as crispy as we would have liked. The Philly Cheesesteak was alright. Of course my brother just returned from Philadelphia so he has a biased opinion.
Our first stop when we got in last night was Luke's. WHAT A WAY to kickoff your vacation. The music was great, the drinks were strong, and the overall atmosphere was so friendly.

Stopped by for what I thought was going to be one drink before I teetered off somewhere else, and ended up here for a few hours. I was at the end of a weeklong conference and walked here with a friend who was staying at this hotel (super cute spot by the way). She mentioned that the bar was pretty good and so the long afternoon began. Sweet bartenders who kept up good conversation while still being very professional.

Ambiance is absolutely amazing and the building and interior design is so perfect.

Between the two of us, we had:
Crow's Nest ($13)
Melonious Funk ($9)
Equinox ($13)
Paint it Black and Gold ($12)

The drinks were delicious, well thought out, and creative. And in a hotel bar? Amazing. By the end I really wanted to order bites but had to rush off to make my flight. I will be back!

So I ordered a pizza online at 5:45 and they said it would be ready to pick up by 6:36. I show up at 6:35 and they said it would just be an extra 10 minutes. Unfortunately I didn't get my pizza until 7:10. While the deep dish is good, thin crust is mediocre or even bad. I'd recommend going somewhere else rather than waiting 90 minutes for a pizza.
First time here.  Food and vibe were great!! Prices are reasonable, overall a great experience.

I don't rate 5-stars for anything less than exceptional, however since the Ale is continuing to take care of all of their employees during this carry out only phase, I'm honored to support them with my business.  In addition, the food was great as usual, and was greeted at the curve with with a kind server, who earned the 20% tip by simply smiling.
Our taco pizza was a little crunchy. but overall service was great beautiful establishment and they remade our pizza to satisfaction!

This place is a gem. I stopped in by myself and ate at the bar. Super friendly wait staff and bartender. Ordered the Rib eye steak and it was great as were the veggies that accompanied it. Very relaxing old school music and great lighting. I will definitely be back.
This place is the best! Honestly,  if I could eat here every day I would.  Food is amazing and the atmosphere is cool..

cold rainy Mothers Day and understaffed valet.  waited 25 minutes to get parked and then almost an hour to get my car to leave.  Buffet was poorly stocked and on the third floor.  Had to walk through a crowded reception area to get to and from the buffet. Wait staff was not attentive with drinks since the food was buffet.  Manager was rude to the dozens of people waiting in the lobby for their cars and insisted on the valets parking the incoming guests prior to getting the cars for the departing guests that had been waiting for so long.  last impression before leaving is the most important - EXTREMELY DISAPPOINTING EXPERIENCE.
We ordered takeouts since covid-19 and it took an hour and they missed two of our sides I would rate 0 stars

This place is the worst Taco Bell I've been to in a long time. The bathroom stunk of urine and I couldn't get service at the counter. Disgusting and terrible service. Don't go here if you don't need to.
This is a great spot for pizza & wine. The dough is flavorful and makes the pizza absolutely delicious!! Veggies are fresh, jalapenos are spicy just like it should be.
Love the chicken fingers! Have had a few pasta dishes which are all excellent as well as their catering which everyone enjoyed

My lovely girlfriend wanted to go to this place for lunch on our first day in Nashville. The decor is very cool and it's a classy place to grab a bite to eat. It kinda felt like I was in a 50's movie, but in a good way. They were playing old black and white films on the tvs above the bar, which is a nice change of pace from sports/news.

Our server was friendly and the service in general was excellent. I got the pastrami sandwich which was pretty good - it came with cheddar and jalapeños, it was moist and flavorful and very filling. The fries were amazing (they were extra crispy which my gf loved, she ate half of them). My gf got the freekeh salad which was good, something different but not amazing. 

This would be an excellent spot for a date night or to grab a drink at the bar.
Went on opening day and the service was super fast. Walked in at 3:15p and had my burger in hand by 3:25p. Of course, I didn't make it very far down the road before the burger was gone. DELICIOUS!!

Went here only because of reviews.  Saw they had doubles and roti and read they were really great.  I guess last Saturday was not a good day for them because everything we tasted was heavily spiced with marsala; everything.   Channa for doubles-marsala, pumpkin-marsala,  curry shrimp-marsala, potato and channa-marsala, even oxtail-marsala.  

Should have stuck with our go to, Tara's Roti shop, but wanted to give someone else a try.  Not again

This place has great service and is hoping. Had chicken Pad Thai and the Hawaiian fried Rice they were both outstanding. The wait was worth it will definitely be going back often. Glad to see they are getting lots of business even in this crazy pandemic. Thanks for some great Thai food.

Stopped on a drive thru Santa Barbara, ordered online. They were ready promptly. Meatball itself was tasty in the meatball sub, but Marinara was missing something. I can't even recall what my husband and I ate but it wasn't very good. The tomato bisque soup and grilled cheese though they were excellent!
Awful food. Who screws up scrambled eggs? Who charges $13 for 1/2 cup of guacamole? This place. Also salsa tasted like tomato sauce. I regret eating here.

I went though the drive through around 10:00 pm and I definitely have to say the line was out to the road and my order was specific. Typically this location never gets my order right, I come for lunch a lot but this visit was on point. My food was fresh, they specifically made my food the way I asked. And the employee Carlos was professional, and accommodating. Tried to leave a tip and he kindly declined. All and all even tho they were going through a late night dinner rush in the middle of a pandemic with limited menu options, my visit was great. But as for my visits during the lunch hour 11:00-1:00 they could be a lot nicer and the cook needs to listen when you ask for extra pickles or sauce.
Best bread best service!! Sweet girls that work here!! Good soups and desserts  . I wish there was one in Phoenix
Food was delicious good customer service my servers Nubia and Flor were so polite and were always on top of my orders making sure my food got to me.

Best Italian I've ever had. Drove by and saw it, figured why not give it a shot. So glad I did. Today was their first day opening back up after this covid-19 pandemic. Food was amazing and the service was superb! Tyler was our waiter and he was super friendly. He knew about everything on the menu and was very social. I highly recommend eating here and try to get Tyler as your waiter, you won't be disappointed.

I hate writing short reviews / get the French toast bagel - take it home and place in your best toaster - toast to your preference - we all know how to play with our toasters -// whipped butter - keep it to yourself - no need to tell....

Let's take the word of my wife who was born in Mumbai. 

After tasting their food, she called it "beautiful" and "authentic." 

What more do you need? 

The reason for this is because she said it didn't have an oily ring to it like a lot of Indian places make. That's how she could tell it was for real. 

I loved it too. The chicken tikka masala has more unique flavors to it than a lot of places serve. We both really enjoyed the rajmah, which is basically an Indian vegetarian bean chili. She had some palak paneer which I didn't try. But she said it was also uniquely flavored. 

I can tell you that this is definitely not "Americanized." This is the real deal. 

Plus, I was able to walk out with two huge export packs of Parle G cookies for $2.99 each. Best price I've ever seen. And they carry Lays Magic Masala chips which I fell in love with on my India trips. 

I've had Indian food at so many places in this area and some of them tasted richer and better to me. But this place is right up there with the best in the city for takeout. 

This place is perfect when you want to scratch your Indian meal and snack itch.

Nice to have a ramen restaurant in this area. Service was good, restaurant was clean. The chicken katsu ramen came with a large portion of crispy chicken, and the ramen was fine - broth was mild but had plenty of toppings. The hakata ramen had 3 large pieces of charsiu and the broth had a richer flavor. Wouldn't mind trying it again!

Came here for dinner and was hoping to catch some live music while sitting outside. They weren't crazy busy but still had a bit of a wait for a seat outside. Wish we had known the entertainment was ending shortly, otherwise we would've just sat inside but was not informed of that (IMO, this was an oversight by the hostess... there's a good chance someone indicating they want to sit outside wants to listen to the music). Anyway, we started with the jalapeño & corn hush puppies and the fish dip. Both were a solid 5/5 stars. The fish dip was fresh mahi and so good. Given are generous portioned appetizers, we decided to split an entree... the grouper tacos. This is where this place fell flat for me. The grouper was good, but the corn tortillas were awful. Inedible in my opinion; I ended up dumping the inside out and ditching the tortilla as it ruined the flavor. I wouldn't rule out coming back and trying something else on the menu (would def come back for appetizers) but the tacos really turned me off. 

The service was pretty decent, no big complaints.

The service is exceptional. Attentive and patient. My burger, which I was so looking forward to from my last experience, was disappointing. I ordered medium rare. It was not rare, and was barely medium. The escargot and Brussel sprouts were very good, although the portions were rather small.

If I could give them 0 stars I would. Their food was bomb af but their service is shitty ! Currently sitting here waiting for my bill the waitress took our order our food came out and I have yet to see her again. ‍
This is always the spot to stop at to eat when your heading north. The food is simple but so good
Waited at the drive through for 45 minutes and they took 3 cars.. I left.. unbelievably slow. They should be extremely ashamed of themselves:. Should not take 15 min to take 1 order!
Our server was missing our food tasted stale and the value for the money is non existent. I think Shells is a better deal. Their whole lobster is like $24.00.
Delicious donuts and coffee!! It's a nice atmosphere too. The cakes are beautiful. I love this place!

I was all excited to eat here because a close friend swore by this place. I ordered takeout & as I was waiting I saw the chef completing orders by open handed grabbing fries (no gloves), his co worker brought a plate of raw shrimp for the chef to inspect & the chef grabbed a couple of them flipping them barehanded, then wiped his hands on his apron then went right back to making burgers! I took my order to go & threw it right in the trash! Cleanliness is next to godliness!!!

Life changing. All I could do was shake my head the entire time. This Pulled Pork Cinnamon Roll is 
$%#%ing Amazing.( Excuse the language). I love looking for different items and after coming across this menu item...I just had to try it. I'm normally not a pulled pork fan, but Lawd...Rick's Reef has turned me out!! Lol. It's soft, with a slight crispy edge, sweet and savory and fully of delicious meat.  I had to slow down eating so it could last longer as the inner fat kid wanted to order one to go but that would delay my summer sexy body...soooo...I refrained.

Fruit bowl was a generous portion for those that felt as guilty as myself by ordering a Cinnamon Roll and the Mimosa gives you a money's worth of champagne.
 
Thank you for being amazing. I was here alone and enjoyed every bit of my guilty pleasure. I live in Tampa but will gladly make this drive for this....after I master this workout plan. 

Folks..get here fast...it's worth it!

Excellent food, atmosphere, and service. Maybe it's hit-or-miss, because I see some bad reviews here, but we had lunch there and it was excellent. I had a salad nicoise that could compete with any Parisian version I've tried, and the latte was superb.

Since moving back to Reno this year, and because of Covid stay-at-home orders, we've been testing various pizzas in Reno. This place was one of the average ones so far. Great location on the corner of Lakeside and Moana, nice restaurant inside too. I initially thought this was a chain (it's really nicely organized and marketed) but happy to find out it's a locally owned place. 

The staff was helpful and were happy employees it seemed.  Pizza was hot and as ordered when we picked it up, and it made the short ride home still in good shape when we sat down to eat. It was good. Toppings seemed fresh and it was well-prepared, not "I can't wait to go here again", but good. There are so many factors involved with having a satisfying take-out pizza experience.  Maybe the stars just weren't aligned on this night for us. 

So we'll likely try it again, and you might want to give it a try, just based on their location, especially if you live towards the center of town, but mostly to give the local owned businesses and chance (and second-chance!).
Alex was amazing!  She knew the beer menu, she was super friendly, she made sure we were happy and she's got a great smile!

The menu looks high-end and a little intimidating but everything on it is worth a try. We've only done takeout but it seems like the most glamorous takeout you can get! Chef level items like you've never tasted and easy takeout/curbside service.
Insanely good food! Downright addictive and much healthier than other "fast" food options.

While this review is strictly for our server I will mention the food and atmosphere are f#*%# amazing

Josh
Been here for roughly 9 weeks ..... if there was a 10 star system he hit ten stars. He was fantastic, we had a shakey start (party of sixteen with two reservations of 8, he handled that shiz well.)

I didn't know what I wanted to drink, he and the bartender put together three phenomenal off menu drinks for me and my group. I am planning on moving to TN and I'm pretty sure we found our  new spot :) thank you Josh for really making this evening the best night of our week!

The food was decent, but the staff seem not to care about my order. They also gave me one Spicy mayo for 4 sushi rolls and when I tried to ask for another one the guy was trying to charge me one dollar for a sauce. If that isn't ridiculous, I'm not sure what is. They also forgot my edamame and my drink.

We just had an order to go of two French dips. The Dutch crunch buns were burnt of course didn't see that until we were home. Hard to believe an employee thought it would be ok to make the sandwich with it so burnt. Bread was soggy just not good. Very disappointed as we've been here numerous times and it's always very good.

10/10 recommend food is so good. Definitely wish they had a location in Bay Area ! 

We had the Mac n cheese hot Cheetos attack and dragon noodles both hit the cravings. They do NOT stingy on food. Worth the price and the portions

THE BEST PIZZA EVERRRRRRRR!!!!!!! First off, always amazing customer service. Secondly, their pizzas are off the chain. We usually get a large with pepperoni, green peps, and banana peppers... sounds weird but it's the jam. 
All of our friends are hooked. Anytime they come over, they always ask if we can order 5 star! 
You seriously can't ask for a better pizza place. Prices are outstanding for the quality and quantity. This isn't your normal "large" pie! Love love love you guys and thanks for all that you do!

The hamburgers & food are not as good as it was even 6 months ago.  Won't be back because this place is dirty.  I'm talking about caked on dirt around the prep area where you order.  Below the counters there are above ground legs with caked on black greasy dirt. Little refrigerator has clogged up vents @ the bottom.  There is a broom leaning against the wall on right of door entering kitchen.  It had greasy dust bunnies across the bristles.  I got a birds eye view when a employee sweep the prep area. Employees are nice and courteous.  Behind the kitchen doors it hopefully is better but doubt it if the area in the public view is this dirty. Pressure wash this place with steaming hot water.
A perineal go to when it has to be on point. When we need a restaurant quality dish that we make at home- this is the place.
Worst service of any fast food location I have visited in recent memory. Would recommend going literally anywhere else unless you have a few hours to wait for cold fries.

This was a wonderful experience. The service at the host stand could've been better, but the food far outweighed this hiccup. Instead of bread you will encounter seafood potatoes...which were great. We then tried the onion rings and the stuffed mushrooms. Okay, so I usually skip onion rings but these are must. Do not skip the onion rings. They are worth it. The onion rings have a slight kick and are lightly battered...amazing. For the entree we had the crawfish étouffée and the shrimp po 'boy. Wow. Just wow. This is exactly what I wanted from New Orleans...and this place delivered.

Ate here on 25th January 2020.  A friend of mine selected this location to get coffee before settling in for a long day of classes for professional development. We used Yelp and noticed it said they opened at  6:30AM. Knowing we had to be in class at 8:00 we were happy to find a craft coffee shop. We arrived at 7:20 and went to head inside and was told by staff that they didn't open for another 10 minutes minutes.  We looked at the door and the door  said 6:30AM.  Anyway we went  back to the car  and waited.   After heading in the staff was uninterested to serve us.  I ordered a bacon, egg, cheese bagel and a large black coffee. Headed to the table and waited for my meal.  While waiting there we watched a customer come to the front door and tried to come in, locked he turned around and left.  Apparently we had came through the back door.  The customer left without service.  Then Another customer  came to the door and we had to ask the staff if they wanted us to unlock the door.  We just got up and unlocked it.  Back to the meal, my sandwich was bland and had little taste so I had to add salt.  The coffee didn't taste bad but I drink mine black so its kind of hard to mess it up, so I thought. An hour later when I finally got to the bottom of my cup I got a mouth full of coffee grounds; see picture.  My friend wasn't impressed with her coffee either.  


Food 2*
Ambiance 3*
Service 3*
Price 4*
Cleanliness 3*

This Portillo's is like the other Portillo's, but it just so happens to be on the south side of Indy. We went through the drive-thru, and I guess the speaker must have not been working, because there was a person standing in front of the speaker taking everyone's order and payment. 

This time, I got the whitefish sandwich, which was a good choice because I was feeling in the mood for a fish sandwich, so it all worked out in my favor. The fish sandwich comes on a brioche bun with tartar sauce. The fried fish was hot and the sauce and lettuce were cool, and the whole sandwich was very satisfying.

Another thing that was satisfying were the onion rings, which were super crunchy. They are almost too crunchy -- if you're trying to eat with any amount of grace and decorum, don't get the onion rings because everyone around you will be assaulted with the sound of your loud crunching. Very uncouth (and yet very tasty).

According to the lady standing in front of the speaker, they "don't have kid-anything," so if you're looking for a kids menu, you can just sod off. There ain't one. You'll need to order food for your child off the regular menu. But they will make their cheeseburgers and hot dogs plain, so that's helpful.
